content: This document is a summary and does not contain all the possible information about the product mentioned. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for your specific needs. Always seek complete information about this product and your individual health requirements from your healthcare provider. Adding plans allows you to compare the formulary status of this product with other drugs in the same category. To access formulary information, you must first create a list of plans. This list can be saved and edited at any time. Adding plans enables you to make informed comparisons. However, the information provided is for general educational purposes only. Individual plans may differ, and formulary details are subject to change. For the most accurate and up-to-date information, contact the relevant plan provider directly. If you choose to send this information to a recipient, they will receive additional details and instructions on how to access the offer.
